items.title: Sculpt and Carve Your Own Mini Jack-o'-Lantern
items.excerpt:
Saturday, October 10th

Skip the mess of real pumpkin guts. Sculpt and carve yours in clay instead! Create a keepsake decoration (or spoopy gift) that won't be compost by Thanksgiving.

Each pumpkin takes about 30 minutes to make and carve, give or take your ambition level. $30 per pumpkin.

Children must be accompanied by an adult.

No experience necessary. All materials included: clay, glaze, and tools. Our instructor will walk you through shaping and carving. We handle bisque and glaze firing.

Please note you won't be taking your pieces home the same day. Work will be ready for pick up approximately 3 weeks after the workshop and we'll email you when it's ready.

Say it with Clay
items.excerpt:
Saturdays, Nov 14 - Dec 19, 10:30 AM - 1:30 PM

Sliding scale pricing (use codes below):

$355-$375-$395

Instructor: Jess Cheng

Want to dive deeper into creative expression with clay? In this 6-week class, we will explore communicating ideas, stories, and emotions with clay as our medium.

Each week we will discuss examples of artwork by a diverse spread of artists and talk about techniques they use to make impactful work. We will take part in idea-generating exercises and share our inspirations and progress with the rest of the class. Demos may include topics such as solid sculpting, bisque molds, large-scale coil building, and more. You do not need to have a particular project in mind beforehand - we will gather inspiration from artists in the field and each other!

items.title: Clay Play: Handbuilt Picture Frames
items.excerpt:
Sliding scale pricing (use codes below):

$65-$80-$95

Make a memorable moment even more unique!

In this 2-hour workshop you'll hand-build your very own picture frame from a slab of clay. No experience necessary, just a love for creativity and a little patience. All materials are included: clay, glaze, and tools. Our instructor will walk you through shaping and decorating your design to match your picture, and you'll choose from two rotating glaze options to finish it off. Our staff takes care of bisque firing and glaze firing the rest.

Please note you won't be taking your piece home that day. Work will be ready for pick up approximately 3 weeks after the workshop, and we'll email you when it's ready.

Codes: SLIDINGSCALE30, SLIDINGSCALE15

items.title: Handmade Altar: 2 Day Workshop
items.excerpt:
Saturday & Sunday, Oct 3 - Oct 4, 12 - 2PM

Sliding scale pricing (use codes below):

$95-$110-$125

Instructor: Bee Ho

No experience necessary, but careful hands and painting skills will be very helpful to get the most out of this class. This is a two-day, back to back workshop in which you will build your altars out of clay slabs for the first session, and then decorate them in the second session.

A flash sheet of decorative motifs will be provided, as well as all tools needed to create your altars. If you would like to create an altar to hang on your wall, please bring any hardware you plant to use with you during the first session to plan around. A simple nail should be enough!

Codes: SLIDINGSCALE15, SLIDINGSCALE30

items.title: Intro To Wheel: 6 Week
items.excerpt:
Sliding scale pricing (use codes below):

$355-$375-$395

This class is ideal for beginners, but also appropriate for those looking for a refresher to improve their technique. This is a 6-week series class with 3-hour lessons every week and includes studio time outside of class as well as materials: one 12.5 lb bag of clay, glaze, and tools. 

Week 1 – Wedging, throwing basic forms

Week 2 – Throwing, trimming

Week 3 – Trimming, attachments 

Week 4 – Surface decoration

Week 5 – Glazing

Week 6 – Glazing

For the first two weeks, we’ll go over centering, wheel skill building, and manipulating clay into a work of art, choosing several to keep. In week three we’ll show you how to refine and finalize your pieces with trimming techniques and attachments. In the final weeks, we’ll guide you through glazing and decorating and you’ll have time to complete your work. Students will be notified via the email used for purchase when their work is ready for pick up, which usually takes about 2-3 weeks.

While we always recommend being able to attend all weeks to ensure you can complete your pottery, we require participants to be present for at least Week 1 Introductions and Week 5 Glazing to ensure you have the necessary information to use our studio safely. If you are absent for these lessons we can not guarantee you will be able to complete your work, and missing this crucial information will disqualify you from using our studio independently in the future without retaking the series.

Codes: SLIDINGSCALE20, SLIDINGSCALE40

items.title: RECC Gift Card
items.excerpt:
Give the gift of artistic expression! Gift cards can be applied to any product, class, or workshop and pair with our sliding scale codes. All gift cards are delivered as a digital code and never expire.

NOTE: Gift cards can not be used for our scheduled booking system reservations such as Day Passes or our Riso Open Studio. They can only be used in our online store for classes and workshops.
